description: Dependency updates with a cooldown: nothing is proposed until a release is 7 days old (plan T11, F8). GitHub Actions and docker images are pinned to digests; npm dependencies to exact versions (the repo already pins). Security advisories are reviewed by hand; the cooldown is not skipped automatically.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions and the workflow container images, one PR, SHA-pinned
Playwright moves monthly; the image digest the runner pins (packages/kit/src/runner/docker.ts) and the container tag in the workflows change with it, by hand, in the same PR
Toolchain: biome, typescript, tsdown, vitest, publint, attw
The peer range on @playwright/test stays a range (>=1.64 <2); only the dev pin moves
Optional natives ship prebuilds and no install script; a bump that adds a script is a decision, not an update
